question: relevance
description: Is the company a plausible SUPPLECO client? Asked through AIGenerator.classify_relevance; only a NO removes a company. Every company, person, address and domain here is invented, and every domain ends in .example. No domain carries a country code that the agent's relevance gate removes as non-European (.br, .in, .au and the like) before the AI is asked: read without .example, as the agent would find it, such a company never reaches the AI, so the page text shows where it is. Over a third of the European companies carry no country code either, so the domain alone never tells a European company from one outside Europe; each of them, too, shows in its page text where it is.The page texts imitate what the scraper takes from a company's own site: meta descriptions, headlines, menus and cookie notices included. The question the AI receives answers NO only when the page clearly shows a company based outside Europe, a contract manufacturer that makes products for other companies' brands, or a business with nothing to do with supplements, health foods or wellness products, and YES otherwise, so a brand outside Europe expects NO and a European brand that makes everything itself expects YES.
